calls.statement:
SELECT c.campaign_id, c.campaign_name, c.start_date, c.end_date, c.holdout_pct, c.mailing_list_size, c.holdout_size,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM campaign_holdout h WHERE h.campaign_id=c.campaign_id) AS rows_h,
 (SELECT count(DISTINCT member_id) FROM campaign_holdout h WHERE h.campaign_id=c.campaign_id) AS distinct_h
FROM dim_campaign c ORDER BY campaign_id

WITH h AS (SELECT DISTINCT member_id FROM campaign_holdout WHERE campaign_id=15),
t AS (SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id FROM fact_campaign_exposure e JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=e.member_key WHERE e.campaign_id=15)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM h) AS holdout_n,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM h WHERE member_id IN (SELECT member_id FROM dim_member)) AS in_dim,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM t) AS targeted_n,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM h WHERE member_id IN (SELECT member_id FROM t)) AS overlap,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_campaign_exposure WHERE campaign_id=15) AS exposure_rows,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM h WHERE member_id IN (SELECT member_id FROM dim_member WHERE join_date > DATE '2025-11-30')) AS joined_after,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM h WHERE member_id IN (SELECT member_id FROM stg_member_updates)) AS in_stg

WITH h AS (SELECT DISTINCT member_id FROM campaign_holdout WHERE campaign_id=15)
SELECT m.marketing_consent, count(DISTINCT h.member_id) AS n
FROM h JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_id=h.member_id AND DATE '2025-11-24' BETWEEN m.valid_from AND m.valid_to
GROUP BY 1
